_comment: M-DEPTH DP3 canonical: the inn's upstairs (private quarters). FIXTURE-FIRST: no fixture needed -- every beat here (the stairs door pair, Lyonette's locked door, the PC's own bed) is reachable from a bare fresh start with zero prior accomplishments/classes, unlike DP1's guild script which needed pre-banked hub-gating state. Sleep-beat PARITY is proven LIVE, not just claimed: this script sleeps at the EXISTING ground-floor `bed` first (baseline: phase_changed + the plain 'You sleep soundly.' fallback, no other toast), then climbs upstairs and sleeps at the NEW `your_bed` (same two events, PLUS one extra flavor toast, 'Your own bed.', fired before them) -- the exact same-events-different-toast contract the brief asked for, demonstrated back to back rather than asserted in a comment. Seed 9 for convention (no rng consumed by anything in this walk -- no combat, no skill checks).
